bibliographic.title: Roulette Russian
bibliographic.author: Cleril
bibliographic.description:
Welcome to the hit new game show, Roulette Russian!

Our contestants will reveal their deepest, darkest, delicious vulnerabilities! Then, they die! Or maybe they don't! Whether it's kill or be killed, nobody will be a stranger!

Roulette Russian is a text-only interactive fiction where you'll play as two distinct contestants. Each round you'll ask your opponent a question, pull the trigger, and then (if you didn't kill them) they get to do the same to you!

Neither I the author, nor you the player, have any control over the bullet! Six chambers, three questions each (at most). Put on a good show!

I love anyone who enjoys my work. To read more of my writings, for free, check out my Patreon.
